note: Motion ids for style.yaml `motion:` and shots.csv `code_motion` (docs/CONVENTIONS.md §3, §6) -> the compose kit call that makes them. Read by people and checks; the kit itself does not read this file. Ids marked engine toon are actions of a method: code character (tools/toon/motion.js timeline `do:`), not COMPOSE calls.

needs: anchors box of the crown / bush / grass (root line: its bottom edge, or point <name>_root)
root edge (the side of the box that stays attached)
pose plates listed in the shot
optional: anchors point for the feet (on: { plate, anchor })
anchors point for the pivot (or bottom)

walk-cycle.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'walk', t: [a, b], to: [x, z] } (feet never slide)

run-cycle.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'run', t: [a, b], to: [x, z] }

jump.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'jump', t: [a, b], height }

turn.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'turn', t: [a, b], face } (feet re-plant)

wave.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'wave', t: [a, b], hand }

cheer.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'cheer', t: [a, b] }

point.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'point', t: [a, b], hand, at }

bounce.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'bounce', t: [a, b], bpm }

look-at.call: TOON timeline clip { do: 'look', t: [a, b], at }

blink.call: TOON automatic (timeline.blink) or { do: 'blink', t: [a, b] }

orbit.call: TOON SHOT camera { move: { t, orbit: degrees } } (tools/toon/project.js)

dolly.call: TOON SHOT camera { move: { t, pos, target } }

crane.call: TOON SHOT camera { move: { t, pos: [x, y higher, z] } }
